# pr-2308: fix(2259): E1 pre-emptive pass re-arms when a fold consumes it without executing

## Description

Fixes #2259

## Mechanism

`_maybeAutoCompact` called the CONSUMING gate (`_messageCapGateReached`, whose one-shot `takePremptivePass` fires "exactly once per refusal") on **every** path — including the unforced post-run fold (`_afterRun`) and the over-window funnel fold. On the gh-1680 shape (cap-unknown refusal arms the E1 pass on a token-healthy transcript), the fold consumed the armed pass, ran unforced, executed **zero** passes (the engine short-circuits under the token trigger), and returned false — the armed remedy evaporated and every next request re-learned the refusal the hard way.

## Fix

`lib/src/cli/agent_cli_compaction.dart`, inside `_maybeAutoCompact` only:

- The consuming gate now runs **only** in the `e1PassPending` branch — the forced pre-flight (`forceE1Pass: true`, `_beginUserPrompt`) where the pass actually executes via `_runAutoCompact(force: true)`.
- Unforced folds consult the LEARNED-CAP dimension only (`messageCapTriggerReached` + `learnedCapFor`): the armed pass is neither consumed nor a trigger there — it survives for the next pre-flight, which consumes it with a forced pass (the gh-1729 peek discipline, AC1 disjunct "pass survives").
- `_messageCapGateReached`'s doc contract updated to match (consuming = forced paths only); boot-cap keeps its existing peeking twin.

Known-cap over-cap behavior unchanged (genuine trigger, still folds + still gates the success verdict); both-dimensions-trip still runs one forced pass; aborted folds still skip the gate entirely (early return precedes it).

## Tests (TDD, red-first)

`test/cli/agent_cli_message_cap_pass_consumption_test.dart` (new):

- **AC1**: arm E1 via cap-unknown refusal on a token-healthy ~30k-token transcript (under the 114,688 trigger, over the 20,000 keep cut so a forced pass genuinely summarizes) → post-run fold fires → the pass must survive and the next prompt's pre-flight must execute it as a forced pass (≥1 summarizer call + `auto-compacted` report). **Red on main (0 receipts), green after the fix.**
- **AC1 REG**: the pass fires exactly once — the third prompt issues no further compaction call.
- **AC2**: same arming → heal retry over-windows → the funnel exhausts its bounded attempts → the armed pass must survive the funnel's unforced zero-pass folds; the next pre-flight executes it. **Red on main, green after the fix.**
- **AC4 grep-guard**: `_messageCapGateReached` has exactly one call site and it is the `e1PassPending ?` forced branch of the ternary.

Evidence: all 3 tests red on unfixed source (verified via stash push/pop round-trip), green after the fix; sibling REG suites all green (42 tests): `agent_cli_resume_boot_cap_test.dart` (boot-cap twins + E1 switch), `agent_cli_over_window_continuation_retry_test.dart` (funnel), `agent_cli_message_cap_heal_test.dart`, `agent_cli_message_cap_test.dart`, `message_cap_store_test.dart`. `dart analyze` clean on both touched files; `dart format` exact (standalone SDK in-worktree; machine dart is guard-killed).

`docs/README.md`. Keep entries factual: paths, commands, invariants.

Full subsystem reference: `docs/agents/sdk-subsystems.md` (SDK) +
`docs/agents/flutter-app-subsystems.md` (app/packages/repo-level).

- `lib/src/approval/` — tool approval gate: tiers, session modes, per-tool overrides, critical-bash interceptor, per-turn grants.
- `lib/src/tools/` — `ask`/`request_secret`/media tools, `read` selectors + archives + sqlite, background shell jobs, availability + load modes.
- `lib/src/env/` — `ExecutionEnv` impls: `LocalShell` (setsid, killTree, drain caps, self-signal immunity), session-correlation vars, in-memory default.
- `lib/src/agent/` — FinalizeGate, tool pairing, session image registry.
- `lib/src/trajectory/` — trajectory ledger core; goldens under `test/trajectory/goldens/`.
- `lib/src/redact/` — layered secret redaction (prompt, tool args, output, logs).
- `lib/src/hashline/` — `[path#TAG]` patch language (SWAP/DEL/INS, stale-tag rejection).
- `lib/src/compaction/` — branch summarization + AutoCompactor → policy: `docs/compaction.md`.
- `lib/src/lsp/`, `lib/src/mcp/` — `lsp` + MCP protocol tooling (lazy servers, pure-Dart transports).
- `lib/src/model_roles/` — roles/fallbacks/keyring/watchdogs + provider catalog; `lib/src/ttsr/` — streaming-interrupt rules.
- `lib/src/skills/`, `lib/src/prompts/` — skills discovery; AGENTS/CLAUDE/GOAL/DESIGN auto-merge into the system prompt.
- `lib/src/task/`, `lib/src/messaging/`, `lib/src/session/attach/` — subagents, inbox fabric, attached sessions → `docs/subagents/README.md`.
- `lib/src/memory/` — long-term memory (hosted `flutter_agent_memory` package) → pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`.
- `lib/src/a2a/` — Agent2Agent client/server/manager (`fa serve --a2a`).
- `bin/fah.dart` + `lib/src/cli/` — the `fa` CLI: REPL, slash commands, headless/serve modes → `docs/agents/cli.md`.
- `lib/src/cube/` — fa_cube sandbox profiles → `docs/cubes.md`; `lib/src/cli/hep.dart` — HEP event protocol → `docs/hep.md`.
- `lib/src/web_search/` — `web_search` (DDG keyless → keyed providers); `tool/fa-clip/` — native macOS pasteboard helper.

**packages/ + app shells:**

## Hard architecture rules (stay inline)

- `lib/` is pure Dart: **no `dart:io`** (must compile for web). The only
  `dart:io` entry points are `bin/` and `lib/io.dart`; file/process/network
  behind tools goes through the `ExecutionEnv` abstraction.
- Barrel `lib/flutter_agent_harness.dart`: grouped **APPEND-ONLY** export
  sections — one `// ── <subsystem> ──` header per group, sorted by path
  within a group, new exports append to their group. No mini-barrels, no
  re-sorting (gh-1232).
- God-file ceiling: no `.dart` file over **2800** lines (crap4dart `loc`
  gate). Target < 2000 for primary files; split by concern into `part`
  files — never by extracting public API.

## Working in parallel (shared checkout + worktrees)

Do not modify files in this shared checkout unless the user asked; run no
heavy commands (full suites/analyze) in it; never `git stash` the user's
WIP; talk to peer agents through the messaging fabric, not their files.
Worktrees only if genuinely required — ask first, create detached under
`.worktrees/<name>/` from the remote tracking ref, remove when done.
Full policy: `docs/agents/parallel-worktrees.md`.

## Memory (footnote)

Before any non-trivial task, **search memory first** (`memory_search`,
then `memory_list` for fuzzy topics). Scopes: **project** = this repo
(`.fah/memory/note/` since gh-2185 — local-only, not committed; the
user's files: read freely, write only via `memory_add`), **user** = global/private. `memory_add` stores durable facts
only; supersede by delete + add — never leave solved problems to rot. The
host recomposes the `<memory>` prompt section after every add; tool wiring
is `memoryTools` + `lib/src/memory/`. Churn pitfalls: `docs/memory-churn.md`;
usage details: `docs/agents/memory-usage.md`.

Any change to `flutter_app/lib/` UI code is INCOMPLETE until its golden
tests are done: coverage first (`test/goldens/` + `golden_guard_test.dart`
map), real fonts (`ensureGoldenFonts`), full frames (1280x800 / 390x844),
determinism, eyes on pixels after `--update-goldens`, green
`flutter test test/goldens` + `scripts/check_goldens.py` (orphan snapshots
hard-fail). Full rules: `docs/agents/golden-tests.md`.

Every LLM prompt is a Markdown file under `prompts/**` (YAML frontmatter,
`{{token}}` placeholders) — never string literals in `.dart`. After
editing: `dart run scripts/gen_prompts.dart` regenerates the `.g.dart`
files (`test/prompts/prompts_sync_test.dart` gates drift); Codex catalog
refresh: `dart run scripts/sync_codex_models.dart`. Details:

prompts-only → size + analyze; lib/bin/test/pubspec → +tests, coverage,
CRAP, dup, dupx; `test/integration/**` → +integration-mock;

Full gate text: `docs/agents/quality-gates.md`; CI workflows: `docs/ci.md`.

Every shared setting and interactive prompt type exists on BOTH the CLI

## Review summary — PR #2308 `fix(2259): E1 pre-emptive pass re-arms when a fold consumes it without executing`

**Verdict: APPROVE** (0 🚨 / 0 ⚠️ / 3 💡 digest / 0 threads)

**What the PR does** (verified against source, not just the description): on `main`, `_maybeAutoCompact` called the CONSUMING gate (`_messageCapGateReached` → `takePremptivePass`) on every path. I confirmed the bug mechanism in the engine itself — `auto_compactor.dart:382` short-circuits unforced runs to zero passes when token-healthy with no learned cap, so an armed E1 pass was taken-and-dropped by the post-run/funnel folds. The fix gates the take behind `e1PassPending` (forced pre-flight only, `agent_cli_run.dart:170`) and peeks the learned-cap dimension on unforced folds. Semantics preserved: forced-but-not-pending and known-cap paths compute identically to before; the boot cap keeps its peeking twin; `wire-serve`/REPL turns route through the forced `_runPrompt` pre-flight.

**Verification run in this session**: `dart analyze` clean on both touched files; `dart format` exact; new AC suite 3/3 green; sibling REG suites 42/42 green (the PR's "42 tests" claim reproduced exactly). The test's fake-stream discriminator is sound — compaction summarizer calls provably carry single-message contexts (`compaction.dart:836`).

**Digest findings** (all pre-existing, none earns a rework lap per §7): three-site duplication of the learned-cap peek (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:455`), the `runHeadless` pre-flight comment now overstating REPL parity (`agent_cli.dart:2452` — in one-shot headless an armed pass has no next pre-flight since the pass is process-local), and the constant-false success verdict when the E1 take fired (`agent_cli_compaction.dart:498`, harmless — the only forced caller discards the bool).
